Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și internet
Our client provides practical solutions related to Data and AI, Cloud Services, Robotics and digital Engineering and Business Process Management to their clients.
 ROLE
 Our client is a leading global technology company seeking a motivated SQL Application Support Engineer to join its IT operations team in Bucharest. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining and supporting critical enterprise applications, ensuring system stability, resolving technical incidents, and contributing to continuous improvements across supply chain platforms.
This opportunity is ideal for an early-career IT professional with strong SQL skills, a solid technical foundation, and an interest in enterprise application support.
 Responsibilities
Manage the daily operation, maintenance, and support of enterprise supply chain systems, including SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SCC, JDA Planning, and related platforms.
Monitor application performance and system health to ensure business continuity.
Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical incidents within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Develop and recommend IT optimization initiatives from an end-to-end systems perspective.
Collaborate with cross-functional technical and business teams to improve application performance and user experience.
Identify recurring issues and contribute to preventive maintenance and continuous improvement.
Participate in on-call rotations or occasional night shifts to support business-critical systems operating 24/7.
 Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
1–3 years of relevant professional experience in IT operations, application support, or software development.
Strong knowledge of SQL and PL/SQL development.
Familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, and MySQL.
Good knowledge of Java, ideally supported by practical experience in Java-based projects.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
Proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Willingness to participate in occasional on-call or out-of-hours support.
 Additional Information
Recent graduates with strong technical skills and relevant academic or project experience are encouraged to apply.
Candidates with fewer than three years of experience will be considered.
The position is based in Bucharest, Romania.
Freelance collaboration.
